items.headline: Gen10 launches conversational AI layer for CTRM
items.summary: Gen10 introduced NaNi, a chat-driven AI interface, and Conductor.AI, a governance layer, letting trading and ops teams book trades and query positions in natural language within its CommOS platform.

items.headline: Tether expands into commodity trade lending
items.summary: Stablecoin issuer Tether has extended roughly $1.5 billion in credit to commodities traders and signaled plans to significantly scale up this lending activity, per ICC Trade Finance reporting.

items.headline: Sanctioned carrier SeaLead Shipping halts operations
items.summary: Singapore-based liner SeaLead Shipping ceased trading and filed for insolvency after US OFAC sanctions disrupted its operations, per The Loadstar, underscoring sanctions-screening risk for charterers.

items.headline: ACER flags gaps in REMIT trade surveillance
items.summary: ACER's annual reports found trading intermediaries' REMIT compliance structures are improving, but called for strengthened, more professionalized market-abuse surveillance and better suspicious transaction reporting.
